_about: Zones, maps and interface text for The Loop Line. Map characters: # and % are walls, . is floor, letters are things defined under 'things'. Angles are in degrees: 0 east, 90 south. Book-derived strings carry a source; everything else is marked as written for the game.

ui._note: Interface text. Written for the game. States no fact from the book. [NOT IN SOURCE]
ui.title: The Loop Line
ui.subtitle: A walk through the cerebellum, built from The Hidden Conductor, a book in progress by Staf Bauer.
intro: You are a signal. The cerebellum is your hub: walk it, then ride the lines out to the rest of the brain and back.
Everything you collect is a card. Each card quotes the book, word for word, with its chapter and page.
Green cards are what the book states as established. Amber cards are hypotheses or revisions. Violet cards are open questions.
ui.disclaimer: The layout is a route map, not anatomy. Apart from the woman in the scan, the people you meet are composite characters, as the book states. This is not medical advice.
ui.controls: Move: W A S D or the arrow keys. Act: E, Enter or Space. Notebook: N. Map: M.
ending: You have walked every line and come back to the scan.
The last card is from the book's epilogue.
